item.title: Inside COP11: A young Filipino advocate saw how the tobacco industry speaks
item.description: “What stood out to me was this: the tobacco industry doesn’t even have to speak in the room to be heard. Its arguments were echoed, almost word-for-word, by the governments that are supposed to be protecting public health.”

item.title: Asserting human rights for everyone and everybody
item.description: Protestors, led by human rights group 'Karapatan,' denounced the unabated human rights violations in the country and the massive corruption involving senators, congressmen, public officials and private contractors.

item.title: Political Drama at Disinformation ngayong 2025
item.description: Sa special episode ng What The F?! podcast, tatalakayin ng VERA Files kasama ang political scientist na si Cleve Arguelles, ang mga maling impormasyong kumalat online ngayong 2025 at kung paano nito hinuhubog ang diskurso sa mga maiinit na isyu ngayon.

item.title: 2025 Oblation Run tackles government corruption
item.description: The Alpha Phi Omega fraternity at the University of the Philippines-Manila held its the annual Oblation Run last Dec. 12 with the massive corruption involving senators, congressmen, public officials and private contractors in the government's flood control projects as the target of its protest action.

item.title: Filipino voices in a Geneva basilica
item.description: For nearly 30 years, an all-Filipino choir has sustained the only English Sunday Mass at the Basilica of Notre Dame.

item.title: All Eyes on AI – Usapang Deepfakes, Disinformation at Digital Literacy
item.description: Sa special episode ng What The F?! Podcast, tatalakayin ng VERA Files kasama si Engr. Ben Hur Pintor – Digital security advocate at Co-founder ng Smart CT, kung paano nakakaapekto ang paglaganap ng AI sa matagal ng problema ng disimpormasyon at anu-ano ang pwedeng gawin para mapalakas ang digital literacy sa bansa.

item.title: Sandatahang Dahas notes alarming increase of brutality by state agents
item.description: In its penultimate month of monitoring for 2025, Sandatahang Dahas recorded an alarming increase of state agents exercising their means for brutality beyond what can be considered justifiable scenarios.

item.title: Pinoy Christmas is reaffirmation of faith, love and family
item.description: This Christmas, amid traffic jams, the crowds, high prices, we persevere. We light up the trees. We put up lanterns. We patiently beat the long queue just to be home for Christmas. We hope and pray that in 2026, the guilty are punished and governance will be better

item.title: Feast of Jesus Nazareno: An unfathomable show of faith and devotion
item.description: The annual procession of Jesus Nazareno, also known as the Black Nazarene, held every 9th of January on the streets of Quiapo in Manila is an awesome scene of deep faith and devotion, not many can fully understand.

item.title: Disinformation to surge as warring political factions brace for 2028 presidential race
item.description: Expect more disinformation as the Marcos and Duterte political factions try to muster support for the 2028 elections, WR-Numero president Cleve Arguelles predicted in the special episode of What The F!? podcast.
